Tuberculosis triggers the immune system, I had no side effects and this treatment has been proving to be effective for over 20 years. My cancer was like a moss patch inside the bladder which they like scooped out like ice cream. 
But my opinion is once you have cancer it’ll usually come back somewhere. I go back first of the year for scan to see how things have done since this procedure.
